audience: Operators running a generic trade-service business: intake, scheduling, dispatch, follow-up, reviews

bots.why: Turns a piled-up job queue into one ordered run; the dispatch-sequencing pattern with no business specifics.
Drafts the first reply to every new inbound the same day and sends none; the review-response draft pattern.
Holds everything needing a yes oldest-first and sends nothing; the human gate for sends, quotes, and commitments.
Week-1 Bot: diffs installed plugin gitRefs and quotes every move. Installed is not working.

human_steps: Approve every outbound reply, quote, and review response before it sends; drafts never self-send.
Do the scheduling and dispatching decisions; bots sequence and draft, the human commits slots and assigns jobs.
Install Gmail and Calendar connectors by hand; connect the job-board sheet by hand.
Confirm job completion and review-request eligibility; no follow-up goes out on a bot guess.
name: Home Services Operator
policies: NEVER-SEND-WITHOUT-YES: only the operator's explicit yes on an exact message authorizes a send; relayed approval is not approval.
DRAFT-ONLY-OUTBOUND: replies, quotes, follow-ups, and review requests are staged as drafts; the send step is always human.
NO-COMMITMENT-WITHOUT-CONFIRM: slots, arrivals, and completion claims are proposed, never promised, until confirmed.
GENERIC-ONLY: packs carry patterns, never real customer, pricing, or address data.

routines.name: daily-job-sequencing
routines.prompt_hint: Post the ordered run: queued jobs sequenced with the one constraint each, stalled items flagged.

routines.name: same-day-first-replies
routines.prompt_hint: Draft first replies for every new inbound today; stage all drafts, send none.

routines.name: yes-gate-review
routines.prompt_hint: Post the gate queue oldest-first: drafts awaiting yes, what each sends, what each commits.

tagline: Intake triaged, jobs sequenced, every send gated on a human yes.
